ValidationRule.description: Prevent edit of an expense by a Sales user after it has been submitted for approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh Sales", NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(Subject__c), ISCHANGED(Travel_Start_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Travel_End_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Purpose__c), ISCHANGED(Submitted_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Remark__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to edit an expense.
